split_source: Same immutable overlap groups and outer folds as classification_cv
validation: Next cyclic fold; every model and recipe chosen only on validation macroF1 then NLL
sampling: Each batch30:10 examples per class, with replacement from training only; two repeats share locus split
augmentation: Reverse both genome axes with probability0.5
loss: Unweighted cross entropy with label smoothing0.05; no extra class weights on balanced batches
normalization: Training-only ShapeTransform per outer fold; no length/type metadata
limitations: Existing outer test positions were examined previously; retrospective comparison
Validation recipe choice is internal; no independent source validation
Repeats share training locations; not cross-replicate training isolation
Only26CHID loci, metrics and model choice may be unstable
